decisions.reason: Safety shoe lines are the firm's core business and usually stay on the market for several years after launch.
The comfort insole is a cheap complementary accessory that supports shoe sales and the foot-measurement service.
The supportive insole serves ergonomic needs at low carrying cost, though it may be consolidated with the other insoles over time.
The ergonomic series has its own web page and targets a growing core segment, so withdrawal within the next year is unlikely.
Certified firefighter boots have long product cycles and high certification sunk costs, so early withdrawal is unlikely.
The moulded insole is presented as a flagship on the home page and is central to the firm's innovation direction.
